note: AEE-relative modelled mass estimator. This file is a model artefact. It is not a catalogue capture and it holds no real-world vehicle value. The estimator reads the vehicle box geometry and the material the engine exposes, applies a cited material density range and a per-mass-class fill range, and returns a bounded range. Every value here is modelled. It never enters data/vehicle/catalogue/, data/vehicle/class_map.json, data/vehicle/coverage.json, the generated matcher, or the NRMM path. The fill ranges are calibrated on in-engine default bounding geometry paired with sourced real-world masses, not on real catalogue dimensions, because the runtime reads the in-game box. Every census pairing is a class_only catalogue analogue and the census is a census of the spawnable ground vehicle population, not a sample. The estimate stays unavailable until calibration passes and a human sets calibration.approved to true. Each mass class resolves to the metal density range by default because the structural mass of a ground vehicle is dominated by metal, and the fill range absorbs the void fraction. The eight material classes are exactly the classifier classes from addons/material/functions/fnc_getSurfaceMaterial.sqf:23-24.

metal.locator: Annex A, steel 78.5 kN/m3 (7850 kg/m3) and cast iron 71.0-72.5 kN/m3 (7100-7250 kg/m3)

rock.source: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics

wood.source: BS EN 338:2016; USDA FPL Wood Handbook FPL-GTR-190 Ch. 5
wood.locator: BS EN 338:2016 strength classes, low-density softwood to high-density hardwood; FPL-GTR-190 Ch. 5 density table

concrete.locator: Annex A normal-weight concrete; BS EN 206:2013 density classes, lightweight to normal

water.locator: density of water at 20 C, 998.2 kg/m3, and at 4 C, 999.97 kg/m3

vegetation.locator: wood-chip bulk density, a proxy for solid vegetation; no solid-vegetation standard located

ground.source: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics (rubber, polymer and leather constituents); BS EN 1991-1-1:2002 Annex A (body material)
ground.locator: residual classifier bucket: rubber/tyre, plastic, cloth, leather and body material; range is wide by construction
ground.note: The classifier residual bucket holds rubber/tyre, plastic, cloth, leather and body material. It has no single solid. The range is wide by construction and the density is not trusted as a physical solid.

power_to_weight.reason: enginePower is a PhysX tuning value with no verified real-world unit (docs/wiki/research/soil-strength-nrmm.md:85); a band needs an in-engine probe
